cd /workspace/task && python3 - <<'EOF'
import csv, json
rows=list(csv.DictReader(open('scratch/orders.csv', newline='', encoding='utf-8')))
paid=[r for r in rows if r['status'].strip()=='paid']
total=sum(int(r['amount_cents']) for r in paid)
out={"paid_count":len(paid),"total_cents":total}
with open('scratch/summary.json','w',encoding='utf-8') as f:
    json.dump(out,f,ensure_ascii=False)
print(out)
EOF
cat scratch/summary.json; echo; md5sum scratch/orders.csv
